results.name: phone pattern: any run of 7 or more digits with separators, an extension, full-width digits folded
scrub: keep values with a letter in any script or 4 or more digits, with Unicode word boundaries
contact links: whatsapp, callto, facetime, skype and wa.me count as contact links
title: an em dash, a middle dot and a colon also separate the name from the product
person link: any id after /user/ or /people/, not only 8 or more characters
